name: Ootori Anko
source:
Affiliation: Felicia All-Girls' School, class 1-A
Class: Martial Art Princess
Hobbies: Saving money, walking through the Chinatown
Favorite food: Anything that sounds cute and is sweet
Disliked food: Sweets that are made from using animals (because she feels bad for them)

The only daughter of the Chinatown's mafia boss' who is Chinese herself. Due to her status as the mafia boss' daughter, she has been equipped with a wide variety of weapons, which she hides, for example, inside her skirt. But despite her status, Anko is a kind and refined girl loved by the people of the Chinatown; she loves them the same amount. For unknown reasons, Anko wants to save a lot of money, which she always puts into her frog purse as her savings.
